# Zebra Browser Print JS SDK

`BrowserPrint.min.js` is the minified Browser Print base library (v3.0.216),
sourced from the npm package `zebra-browser-print-min` (jsDelivr CDN mirror of
Zebra's SDK).

It talks to the native **Zebra Browser Print** desktop application on the
workstation. Without that app running, label printing will fail with a clear
error in the UI.

See `docs/docker.md` → section „Artikeletiketten (Zebra ZD220)“.
